name: Assassin's Contract
summary: In Hillsbrad Foothills, a Shadowy Assassin bears a contract naming Magistrate Henry Maleb for death. You are to carry it to Maleb in Southshore, where red wax bears a distinctive signet ring's mark.

sections.title: A Marked Magistrate
sections.body: A Shadowy Assassin carries a contract in Hillsbrad Foothills. It names Magistrate Henry Maleb for death, and a distinctive signet ring has marked the red wax. Bring the paper to Maleb in Southshore.

sections.title: Maleb's Verdict
sections.body: Magistrate Henry Maleb reads the contract and says it explains Southshore's recent attack. He is certain the Syndicate wants his life, as it wanted the previous magistrate's.

faq.q: What is written in the contract?
faq.answer: The contract orders Magistrate Henry Maleb's killing. Red wax seals it, marked by a distinctive signet ring.
A Shadowy Assassin carries the contract in Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: To whom should the contract be delivered?
aliases: who do I give the contract to
where to turn in assassins contract
faq.answer: Bring the contract to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore. He is the magistrate it names for death.
